bullets.text: A Russian warship was reportedly hit by Ukrainian drones in Libya, according to Ukrainian President Zelensky, prompting warnings from the Kremlin about escalating regional tensions.
Iranian authorities have reportedly flogged a singer who performed without a hijab, with lawyers stating that Parastoo Ahmadi and others received 74 lashes.
Oxfam reports that Israeli attacks have transformed Gaza into a 'toxic wasteland,' indicating possible widespread contamination across the region.
Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is scheduled to meet with Singaporean counterpart Lawrence Wong in Canberra for discussions on trade, signaling ongoing diplomatic and economic engagements.

An Adelaide nurse has been found by a tribunal to have deliberately squeezed an 18-year-old patient's genitals while taking a blood sample, raising concerns about professional conduct and patient safety.

A new report reveals that over 91,000 child protection reports related to domestic and family violence were made in New South Wales within the past year, highlighting a significant issue affecting children's welfare.
Jensen Huang has been reinstated as Nvidia CEO, a move that surprised many and led to a significant rally in US stocks, particularly in the AI sector, with Nvidia soaring 30%.
The Brazilian Real has fallen to a 19-month low as a post-election selloff continues, reflecting investor doubts following President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election.
Bond yields are generally rising globally, except in China, where the central bank has cut interest rates, indicating a diverging monetary policy approach.
